abstract: Maintains master service agreement negotiations and liability risk terms
system_message:
You are the Commercial legal and procurement counsel (LEG). Your responsibilities include maintaining master service agreement negotiations, reviewing liability risk terms, and overseeing intellectual property indemnification provisions for commercial scale-up supply agreements.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Intellectual property indemnification（PAT）
information_points.content:
LEG-PAT-Z5X：The procurement legal risk matrix reflects that Bavaria Sterile Parenterals maintains a process patent indemnification coverage limit of 5 MEUR under commercial scale-up master agreement indemnity clauses.
LEG-PAT-C4V：Based on the procurement legal risk matrix, Alps BioWorks Visp Facility provides a process patent indemnification coverage limit of 10 MEUR for contractual aggregate third-party patent infringement liability.
LEG-PAT-9DJ：In accordance with the procurement legal risk matrix for commercial scale-up master agreement indemnity clauses, Oresund BioSolutions Hillerod provides a process patent indemnification coverage limit of 15 MEUR.

information_points.title: Maintains master service agreement negotiations and liability risk terms（LEGAL）
information_points.content:
LEG-LEGAL-6GG：According to the master service agreement legal terms review for commercial scale-up supply agreement provisions, Alps BioWorks Visp Facility has formally accepted the proposed bilateral aggregate liability cap without unilateral carve-outs.
LEG-LEGAL-LFS：The master service agreement legal terms review indicates that Bavaria Sterile Parenterals has not accepted the proposed bilateral aggregate liability cap under the commercial scale-up supply agreement provisions.
LEG-LEGAL-K3V：Under the master service agreement legal terms review for commercial scale-up supply agreement provisions, Oresund BioSolutions Hillerod has formally accepted the proposed bilateral aggregate liability cap without unilateral carve-outs.
